programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade ends the saga with a deer he has watched for a few years, Pope. On a previous episode you saw Slade put in all of the work with feeder and food plot strategy to make the stars align. Make sure you watch that episode as well to see the behind the scenes work it took to bring Pope to 25 yards.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Opening Week in Mississippi started off with a BANG!!"
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we take you to historic Saint Francisville, Louisiana. We closed on a couple of real estate properties in this area and want to show you why this area is so unique from a recreational standpoint. This place holds the “old south” feel that is ever so fleeting. We hunt on a property I sold to a client last year in Saint Francisville and manage to get a beautiful longbearded turkey on the ground. This episode is one you definitely don’t want to miss.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive into how we are using our knowledge and experience to not only get some amazing hunting property, but to have other people pay for it. Sound too good to be true? - We also take you on some great hunts we’ve had on our journey flipping land and think back on some memories from the past and what the future is going to look like. - We hope you can learn a thing or two in this episode and encourage you to reach out with any questions you may have about this process.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes you on a ride through one of the coolest cities in the south, the historic Natchez, Mississippi. This is an area in which Slade sells a lot of hunting land and being only 40 minutes from where he grew up, Slade is very familiar with all there is to do in the area not only from a recreational standpoint but also for entertainment. Slade takes you through the showing process on a beautiful piece of property and bring it full circle at the closing. You’ll also watch a deer hunt with Slade in Natchez that was featured on Realtree Monster Bucks DVD. This is a jampacked episode with so much to learn and also enjoy. We know you’ll love it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.desc: The stage is set at the Collegiate National Championships for a high-stakes final showdown between the defending champions, the University of North Carolina Tar Heels, and the powerhouse University of Virginia Cavaliers. In an electric atmosphere fueled by a raucous Virginia crowd, the "third man" in the stands, both teams battle for the ultimate prize: the national championship trophy. programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Kao/DeHeart vs. Fudge/Munro
programme.desc: Watch a thrilling Mixed Pro Doubles pickleball match between the top-seeded team of Megan Fudge and Jack Munro against Peichuan Kao and Ryler DeHeart. Megan Fudge is a highly-ranked professional player who previously played tennis at the University of Illinois, where she met her husband and partner, Ryler DeHeart. DeHeart is a former professional tennis player who is left-handed. Their opponents are Peichuan Kao, a professional pickleball player who won gold at the APP Fort Lauderdale Open, and Jack Munro, a young pro who was the youngest to become a professional at age 12.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.sub-title: Troubadour Club 2024 – Exhibition Match – Johnson & East vs Kennedy & Burrows
programme.desc: Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Tortuga en la vagina; Me enseñaste a odiarte
programme.desc: Fue detenida por tráfico animal, ella culpa a Roberto por la tortuga que lleva en la vagina. Exige emanciparse de su padre por su comportamiento violento, él alega que la agresiva era la madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo muere porque la ambulancia no llegó a tiempo al hospital, ella demanda al chofer. Pablo y Ernesto tienen una relación de amor, odio, deseo y celos que no los deja vivir en armonía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maruchka demanda a su amiga Lily por publicar un video de ella donde se muestra su sobrepeso. Julio y Martina están en desacuerdo sobre el medicamento que le recetó el pediatra a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Terror a la migra; Venta de información
programme.desc: El hijo de Lilian muere a consecuencia de un ataque de pánico provocado por una broma que hicieron en su colegio. Además, David, quien fue víctima de hackers, contrata a Samuel como modelo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Demasiado con tres y se sumó uno; Babysitter chapeadora
programme.desc: Marie y Neysi reciben clases de baile, las graban y suben los videos a la web para ser vistas por presos. Elisa pierde a un cliente porque Garnet la denunció como secuestradora de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro fue golpeado por vándalos y en la cirugía dañaron su cerebro, ahora no controla sus instintos sexuales. Alexandra descubre que su inquilina tiene un negocio clandestino de placer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio un cazatalentos de jugadores de béisbol, termina involucrado en un problema de drogas. Luis le dijo un piropo fuera de tono a Isabel, y ella reacciona mal al sentirse acosada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Wilmer pide anular el testamento de su papá porque deja como heredera a la niña de Sandra, quien lo engañó. Melissa busca recuperar a su hijo, quien fue adoptado por Raúl y su esposa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mujer que no existe; La pandora

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El chupón estafador; Mascota de moda

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Ángel le dispara al perro de su vecina, ella pide compensación, él alega que fue en defensa propia. Venda un ovario y años después se entera de que en la cirugía le extirparon el útero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Al salir en libertad, Diana le pide a Ceci que le dé la propiedad que tienen en común porque cumplió prisión por su culpa. Fidel le promete a Lorena que en tres meses triplicaría la inversión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía le exige a su esposo Carlos, un venezolano que quiere regresar a su patria, que pida asilo político en los Estados Unidos, de lo contrario pide el divorcio y la custodia total de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Seguros médicos vs. religión; Madre abandonó a los tres años
programme.desc: Alejandra demanda a su jefe por suprimir la cobertura de anticonceptivos de su seguro médico. El padre de Susana desaparece, ella exige su emancipación y una orden de desalojo para su madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Oxitocina para infieles; Mundial: México vs. Brasil
programme.desc: Orlando demanda a su esposa, pide el divorcio y 50 mil dólares, ella lo medicó para someterlo. Arturo es mexicano y Suzzy es brasileña, todo iba bien, pero el fútbol los convirtió en rivales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate a suspected haunting in an old multi-use church. However, the investigation takes an unexpected emotional turn as they connect with a surprising spirit. What begins as a typical haunting becomes deeply personal, and the team moves from assumption to affirmation—all caught on camera.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior, ignorando que Rosa es su hermana, le jura amor eterno y le pide casarse cuanto antes. Rosa siente la angustia de no poder decirle la verdad. Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. Antes de llevarlos a la prisión, deja a ella hacer su último descargo con Rodrigo en el que le confiesa que nunca lo perdonará por arruinarle la vida.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108 (2026)
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Shadows of the Rubber Boom
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.desc: Sarah and her family enjoy an early morning adventure at Chundu Island Safari Camp. Using the the Zambezi River as a backdrop, she cooks a meal of chicken tikka skewers, fish frikkadels and banana brûlées with dark chocolate.

programme.title: Wine, Dine and Stein
programme.desc: Chef Jack Stein travels with his family to find the ultimate pairings with wine and food.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Providencia & the Wisdom of the Bora
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.sub-title: American Travelers: New Zealand Australia Adventures
programme.desc: Dave and Kari take a cruise to New Zealand, Tasmania, and Australia.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Greenbrier County, WV
programme.desc: Join Nick and Brian as they discover the true beauty of Greenbrier County. After settling in downtown Lewisburg, they explore Cold War secrets, birds of prey, an awesome river trail and go deep into the earth. They also meet a new friend named Marcel.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.desc: La adolescente Carmín ve desvanecerse su sueño de mudarse a la ciudad junto a su madre Doris, quien decide partir a Estados Unidos con su nuevo esposo. Ahora, Carmín crece y vive en Barranquitas, un pintoresco pueblo montañoso en el centro de Puerto Rico, bajo el cuidado de su abuela, una mujer firme y de convicciones conservadoras. La llegada inesperada de su padre Rubén, después de años en prisión, trae consigo una mezcla de alivio por su presencia y complicaciones por las ambigüedades en su relación. Ahora, Carmín se enfrenta a aprender a vivir entre el abandono y la cautela, mientras navega entre la ausencia, el deseo y el amor. La dinámica familiar se entrelaza con los desafíos de su adolescencia, mientras ella busca entender y reconciliar los sentimientos encontrados que surgen con la reaparición de su padre en su vida.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: You Said It, Now You’re Canceled! Pt 2
programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ways To Take Charge Of Your Health
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: During the holidays, the average American consumes 619 extra calories daily! Fitness guru Jillian Michaels joins "The Doctors" to offer tips to keep your family’s figures slim and svelte while celebrating the season!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Staying healthy can sometimes feel like a challenge too large to overcome. Talk-show host Montel Williams joins THE DOCTORS to help you take charge of your health! Previously on THE DOCTORS, Montel helped motivate Alex, who suffers from dystonia. See how she is doing now and learn about a procedure that may help Alex overcome the disorder! Do your family dinners lack the proper nutrition? Montel makes a house call and provides one family with an action plan for healthier eating. The outbreak of the swine flu caused a nationwide scare. Now, the vaccine for the strain of flu is cause for concern. Former acting U.S. Surgeon General, Steven J, Galson, answers your H1N1 vaccine questions.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Where, When and Why
programme.desc: From when your child should start talking to why hormones affect your mood, The Doctors tackles your biggest who, what, where, when and why questions. And, get the most effective home remedies from around the globe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors is giving prostate exams throughout the show and Dr. Ordon and former NBA star John Salley are taking one for the team! In an exclusive interview, The parents of a little boy whose skin blisters when you touch him share what daily life is like. See The surprise that leaves him speechless! Young Hollywood stars and artists tackle The global water crisis! Find out how you can help! Then, see the marriage proposal that involved a dramatic set up and … projectile vomiting?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Comedienne Niecy Nash goes on assignment to uncover mystifying body quirks and what you can do about them. And, a new, minimally invasive procedure promises to put an end to heavy periods. Plus, common sex mistakes men make.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Fix It or Live With It?
programme.desc: Embarrassing conditions, annoying problem areas, unsightly body parts … everyone has at least one or two. But you don’t have to be stuck with them! Get solutions for painful heartburn, frequent urination, stuttering and more.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Do you get body tremors? Does your butt jiggle? Do you tremble when you get a high fever? Learn why your body shakes, shimmies and shivers! And, shake your way to a better physique.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Backaches, allergies and toothaches are among the most common recurring health problems. Find out how to keep your chronic medical issues from coming back, and learn to keep body odor and bad breath at bay.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From backaches, to headaches to earaches, learn simple solutions to relieve nagging aches and pains. And, learn a unique and effective way to treat colicky babies.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: A month into the new year, and if you’ve gotten off track with your resolutions, don’t worry. Editor-in-chief of Prevention, Liz Vaccariello, joins The Doctors with simple ways to revitalize your will power.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you constantly surfing the net trying to self-diagnose a mysterious pain? The Doctors reveal what symptoms are safe to ignore and when you need to pay closer attention. Learn the safe and scary causes of numbness, heart palpitations, easy bruising and more

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Witness the most dramatic makeovers ever seen on television; see miraculous transformations and lives changed forever. Dr. Bill Dorfman performs a Gummy Makeover. And, the latest surgical procedure that promises to lengthen limbs.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Decipher the clues and warning signs your body is giving you. Witness a life-saving surgery that a mother and daughter underwent together! Plus, learn what kind of bruises can indicate a serious medical condition.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: An alarming number of children are developing food allergies. Is your child one of them? Learn how to recognize symptoms and what treatments can keep your child safe. Is the fastest way to lose weight … eating more cookies? See if the controversial Cookie Diet is right for you! Find out what every woman needs to know about menopause, including the latest treatments to make the transition easier than ever! Do organs have memories? Learn about the fascinating research conducted on organ transplants and cellular memory.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Bizarre in The E.R. - strange but true emergency room stories you won’t believe! Plus, “The Doctors Court” discusses how an ex-inmate is suing a jail for $5 million after he claims They ignored his 91-hour surprise erection! And, a brand new dad was arrested for selling heroin in the hospital’s maternity ward! Then, should high school students be segregated at lunchtime by their GPAs? And, don’t look now ladies, but pimple-popping nails are in vogue! Would you try them?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Nose Was Destroying My Life
programme.desc: A woman left deformed and devastated by a medical condition gets a new nose and a new lease on life! The Doctors debates a new ADHD medication for kids that tastes like candy! Can Botox be addictive? Find out! Plus, go inside the mind of a serial killer with a woman who was obsessed with one for years! The Doctors breaks down how many cups of coffee to drink to reduce your risk of Alzheimer’s. Is hitting the gym on the weekend enough to make a difference? Hear what science has to say!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The holidays are just around the corner! Get delicious recipes to cut fat and calories from traditional Thanksgiving fare. And, three tips to prevent overeating! Plus, burn off extra pounds fast with the No Excuses workout.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Fix your biggest pains with food! Learn how what you eat can help heal heartburn, soothe toothaches, ease PMS symptoms and more. Plus, snacks that can make migraines and earaches worse. And, how a dill pickle could ease arthritis.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Crackling fires, hot cocoa and snowy slopes are all part of winter’s charm. But cold weather can also be hazardous to our health. Learn how to stay healthy and avoid winter mishaps. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears fields questions from youngsters that include whether it’s safe to eat snow, why noses turn red in the cold and what to do if your tongue sticks to a frozen pole! And, Dr. Jim shares his top ten family winter safety tips. Are food cravings seasonal? When it’s cold outside, you may have the urge to eat more carbohydrates, but find out what your body is really telling you! And, plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon shares at-home remedies to soothe dry, chapped skin and conditioning secrets to tame your mane.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors go Live in the OR to witness a knee replacement surgery! Woman finds out if she’s been catfished! Viral TikTok star talks about her life living with alopecia! Missouri woman fights to keep pet monkeys she claims helps her with PTSD!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Hot and Cold Edition
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals the best hot and cold remedies for ailments. And, surprising ways the weather can sabotage your health. From winter storm warnings to heat waves, learn how to keep your family safe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Exclusive: A woman famous for her 70-inch booty visits The Doctors! Is she in for a shocking diagnosis? Then, are you upping your family’s fire risk without even knowing it? We reveal three dangerous household items! Plus, a woman desperate to walk again turns to The Doctors for help!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Don't Let It Happen to You
programme.desc: The Doctors are joined by home improvement guru and safety expert, Eric Stromer, to share important tips about home, flood and fire safety. Learn what to do if you find yourself in a dangerous situation. And, kitchen safety rules to live by.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: One of the biggest thrills of parenting is learning that your child has a big heart. But one of the biggest terrors is learning your child has a defective heart. Special guest Dr. Gregory Fontana is one of the leading pediatric heart surgeons in the country.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, a Teen Mom star who thinks she was misdiagnosed with a mental health disorder comes to the show for a second opinion! Plus, the shocking story of a baby born with two noses! Then, Dr. Pimple Popper returns to discuss two gross viral videos: the “grandmother of all blackheads” and a popped blister you have to see to believe! And can you be too fat for fitness? A fitness teacher called out for her weight is here to set the record straight!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Insta-famous fitness star Abby Pollock is known for her “peach booty” that’s so perfect some say it’s fake! A live glute ultrasound reveals the truth, while Abby shares a shocking admission about her past. When a bad habit becomes debilitating, a woman turns to The Doctors for help! Special correspondent Rosie Mercado joins The Doctors and is shocked to hear that people are putting apple cider vinegar… down where? Is there any truth to the internet rumor urging women to try DIY “tightening”? Could a contraceptive gel for men change birth control forever? Should you stay friends with your ex? Hear what The Doctors has to say! Then, Dr. Travis tears up as he talks about his beloved dog, Nala, and her health struggles. A 97-year-old record-breaking sprinter … how does he do it? And, the easiest way to peel garlic, ever!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Live fast, die young, party all night – rock and roll’s infamous lifestyle is in the spotlight. Learn how to stay safe while you have fun! Plus, the daughter of shock rocker Alice Cooper shares stories from life on the road.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors checks in with a Season 10 guest who dropped over 300 pounds naturally after he received one of the most graphic skin removal surgeries ever! How is he doing today and what weight-loss advice does he have? “Good & Cheap” author teaches us how to eat healthy for four dollars a day! Controversial study claims women should have shorter workweeks than men? What do our hosts think? Smartphone notifications aren’t just annoying – They might be messing up your brain permanently!

programme.title: The Doctors

The only white man in the area, Cobra Verde finds himself the victim of torture and humiliation. Later, he trains soldiers in a rebel army. Far from home, Cobra Verde is on the edge of madness.

programme.title: Metroland (1998)
programme.desc: After ten years absence Toni, Chris's best friend, suddenly reappears in London to bring chaos and doubt into Chris's calm, tranquil, slightly boring, predictable life. Chris starts to remember his carefree youth as a photographer in Paris when he lived with and enjoyed a torrid affair with Annick. It was also in Paris that he first met and fell in love with Marion. The temptations and pressure exerted on Chris by Toni to return to their former carefree life of sex, drugs and rock'n'roll soon starts to have an impact on Chris's marriage. He starts to question his values, his lifestyle choices and his relationship with Marion and even suspects her of starting an affair with Toni whom she dislikes! Eventually circumstances come to a head and Chris is forced to decide whether to follow Toni back to the hedonistic, irresponsible life of his youth or face the harsh realities of the present and stay with Marion.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven (1966)
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven (1969)
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride! (1972)
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba (1970)
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: Robbers' Roost (2023)
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Gunslinger (1956)
programme.desc: When the town marshal is gunned down, his wife Rose (Beverly Garland) dons his badge. But now an evil dancehall diva (Allison Hayes) wants her dead and hires a gunslinger (John Ireland), who agrees to kill Rose...until he falls in love with her!

programme.title: Southwest Passage (2023)
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James (2023)
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: The King And Four Queens (1956)
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Red River (1948)
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers (2025)
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo (1960)
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks (2023)
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: «Enséñame a vivir» narra el reinado de terror de un asesino en serie que rompe la paz de una ciudad tranquila. El número de víctimas no deja de crecer, y el miedo se apodera de todos. La policía cree haber atrapado al culpable y lo encierra, dando el caso por cerrado. Pero entonces ocurre un nuevo asesinato. Un psiquiatra se ofrece a ayudar en la investigación y accede a reunirse con el sospechoso... quien le revela una verdad aterradora y mucho más peligrosa de lo que nadie imaginaba.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación destapa una serie de asesinatos con el mismo patrón, ocurridos hace 25 años. Su autor, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua y acaba de ver rechazada su libertad condicional por la comisión de Lavrov. Entre tensiones con Lavrov, Storozheva lo acompaña a visitar al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó el caso original... pero se niega a colaborar y actúa con sospecha. Al vigilarlo, descubren su vínculo con Gavrishin, el principal sospechoso de aquellos crímenes.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita visita a Katya, la exesposa de Lavrov, para confirmar su coartada, y sale convencida de su inocencia: informa a su superior, Nikushin, que el verdadero objetivo del asesino podría ser Lavrov, y Katya la próxima víctima. Nikushin toma personalmente su seguridad. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor muerto en la infancia, y Lavrov empieza a sospechar de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien padece trastorno de identidad disociativo.
